language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hello! My name is Nikos. Welcome to my family’s theatre! We have many shows here, and have to make sure everything is in its place. This takes a lot of moving of objects.

When you apply pressure on an object to move it away from you, this is called a push. To pull an object means to move an object towards you. Objects around the theater all have different shapes and sizes and take different amounts of force to move.
Statues like this, for example, are very heavy and need to be pulled across the stage on a cart with wheels. Other things like this box are much lighter and can be pushed across the floor.
Will you help me get everything in the right place for the show tonight?
Don’t forget that backstage needs to be cleaned up too!

The type of surface that an object rests on affects how easy it is to move something across it. This is because of the friction on the surface.

Surfaces that are rough cause more friction than smooth surfaces. The more friction, the harder it is to move objects across a surface. Can you help me pick which surfaces are the easiest to push or pull an object across?

helperSimple.text: Click on the smoothest object that you see. The object has the least friction which means it is easy to push or pull something across it.

dialog.text: The size, weight, and shape of an object affects how easy it is to move. If an object is very heavy, you need many people to move it. Can you help determine the number of people that are needed to move the following objects around the stage?

helperSimple.text: Match the object with the number of people it would take to push or pull it across the stage, based on the size and weight. The heavier and larger the object, the more people it will take to move it.
